```yaml
name: Draft Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      new_version:
        description: 'New version (e.g., 1.2.3). If omitted, auto‑detect.'
        required: false
        type: string
      model:
        description: 'Model abbreviation (codex, glm, kimi).'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  draft_release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Verify authorized actor
        if: ${{ github.actor != 'dyoshikawa' && github.actor != 'cm-dyoshikawa' }}
        run: |
          echo "Unauthorized actor: ${{ github.actor }}"
          exit 1

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Resolve model
        id: resolve_model
        uses: ./.github/actions/select-opencode-model
        with:
          input-text: ${{ github.event.inputs.model }}

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Melos
        run: npm install -g melos

      - name: Determine new version
        id: determine_version
        run: |
          if [[ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.new_version }}" ]]; then
            echo "new_version=${{ github.event.inputs.new_version }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            NEXT_VERSION=$(melos version --dry-run | grep -Eo 'New version: [0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | awk '{print $3}')
            echo "new_version=${NEXT_VERSION}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create release branch
        run: |
          git fetch origin main
          git checkout -b release/v${{ steps.determine_version.outputs.new_version }} origin/main
          git push -u origin release/v${{ steps.determine_version.outputs.new_version }}

      - name: Create draft PR
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: release/v${{ steps.determine_version.outputs.new_version }}
          title: "Release v${{ steps.determine_version.outputs.new_version }}"
          body: |
            Draft release for version ${{ steps.determine_version.outputs.new_version }}.
            Model: ${{ steps.resolve_model.outputs.cleaned-text }}
          base: main
          draft: true

      - name: Create draft release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ steps.determine_version.outputs.new_version }}
          name: v${{ steps.determine_version.outputs.new_version }}
          body: |
            Draft release for version ${{ steps.determine_version.outputs.new_version }}.
            Model: ${{ steps.resolve_model.outputs.cleaned-text }}
          draft: true
          prerelease: false
          target_commitish: release/v${{ steps.determine_version.outputs.new_version }}
```
